headline: Pakistan cut petrol by Rs6.59 to Rs346 per litre and high-speed diesel by Rs4.25 to Rs378 per litre, applicable from Nov 7 to 10, its fifth consecutive fuel price cut, Arab News reports citing Radio Pakistan.

card.desc: Petrol Rs346, diesel Rs378 fi litre, 7 se 10 November tak

caption:
Petrol Rs6.59 aur diesel Rs4.25 fi litre sasta!
Arab News ke mutabiq Radio Pakistan ne bataya ke petrol ki nayi qeemat Rs346 aur high-speed diesel ki Rs378 fi litre ho gayi hai, jo 7 se 10 November tak lagu rahegi. Yeh fuel qeematon mein musalsal paanchvi kami hai.
Kya is kami ka asar aap ki jeb par parega? Comment mein batayein 👇
